fields.name: buttons_pressed
fields.description: Count of button presses completed so far. A press is completed in the step whose execution frames show either a button 'is pressed down' or the gripper at a button's [y, x] (within a few pixels) at height below about 0.06 with fingers closed. 0 at the first step (no execution frames), 1 at the step after the first such frame, 2 from the step after the second to the end. e.g. 1

fields.name: green_container
fields.description: Current [y, x] of the container hiding the green cube. At step #1 (before any container exists) it is the green cube's own position. From the step where containers appear, it is the position of the container that came down on the green cube, then followed by chaining through every frame shown: starting from the previous step's last frame, each container is matched to the container of the previous frame with the smallest displacement (the gliding may already be under way in the first frame of a step). During a press two containers glide around each other; a single circling pass ends with them swapped, a double pass ends with them back at their starting spots, and the chain decides which. The three color chains (green, red, blue) are run jointly as a one-to-one assignment frame to frame: in each frame every container gets exactly one color, so no two color fields end on the same container and no moving container is left unassigned. When the two nearest candidates for one color are nearly tied (displacements within a few pixels of each other), the tie is broken by the assignment that leaves a distinct container for the other colors with the smallest total displacement. A step whose last frame shows the containers in the same arrangement as the previous step's last frame is not evidence that nothing moved: when any intermediate frame shows a container displaced, every color is re-chained through every frame, and the result is usually two colors swapped. Example: carried green [100, 166]; frames show a container at [101, 168], then [110, 178], [125, 182], [130, 163], last frame [130, 160]; write [130, 160] even though the goal names only blue. Value is the tracked container's position in the last frame shown. The tracked container changes identity only where a frame-to-frame link in the chain says so: when the tracked container does not move across a step (jitter of a few pixels aside), the field keeps that same container's last-frame position and never switches to another stationary container, even one standing near an earlier value. The field is filled at every step that shows containers, whether or not green is named in the goal. Once the cube beneath it is visible (container lifted or held in the gripper), the field becomes the cube's position and from then on keeps the cube's last visible position, even after a container is lowered back over it. e.g. [109, 126]

fields.name: red_container
fields.description: Current [y, x] of the container hiding the red cube, kept exactly like green_container: cube position at step #1, then the container that covered it, followed by chained smallest-displacement matching frame by frame from the previous step's last frame (one circling pass swaps the pair, two passes return them; trust the chain), chained jointly with green and blue as a one-to-one assignment per frame, near-ties broken by consistency with the other chains, re-chained at any step whose frames show a container displaced even when the step's first and last layouts look identical, written at the last frame shown, the same container kept whenever it does not move across a step and its identity changing only through a chain link, filled at every step that shows containers whether or not red is named in the goal; once the red cube is visible, the cube's last visible position, kept after the container is set back down. e.g. [82, 152]

fields.name: blue_container
fields.description: Current [y, x] of the container hiding the blue cube, kept exactly like green_container: cube position at step #1, then the container that covered it, followed by chained smallest-displacement matching frame by frame from the previous step's last frame (one circling pass swaps the pair, two passes return them; trust the chain), chained jointly with green and red as a one-to-one assignment per frame, near-ties broken by consistency with the other chains, re-chained at any step whose frames show a container displaced even when the step's first and last layouts look identical, written at the last frame shown, the same container kept whenever it does not move across a step and its identity changing only through a chain link, filled at every step that shows containers whether or not blue is named in the goal; once the blue cube is visible, the cube's last visible position, kept after the container is set back down. e.g. [102, 79]

fields.name: picked_colors
fields.description: Ordered list of cube colors whose hiding container has been lifted so far. Written as the literal JSON text with double quotes and no spaces: [] when empty (including at the first step), ["red"] after the red cube has been exposed, ["red","green"] after both; a single-quoted list such as ['red'] is not the recorded value. [] until the step whose execution frames show a cube visible beneath a lifted or 'held in the gripper' container; then that cube's color is appended, and the list is kept afterwards. e.g. ["green"]
